newsitem.title: USA: Patina mulling higher capital expenditures.
newsitem.headline: Patina mulling higher capital expenditures.

text.p: Patina Oil & Gas Corp said it may increase its capital expenditures as soon as the fourth quarter of 1997 or in early 1998 and is exploring acquisition and development opportunities.

The company, which announced it turned a profit of $0.01 per share in the second quarter compared with a loss of $0.10 in the 1996 period, said the results of its modest capital program had shown significant promise.
Patina's most recent quarter reflected the May 1996 acquisition of Gerrity Oil & Gas.

The company also said it is dedicating "considerable time and effort" to formulating and putting in place a long-term acquisition and development strategy and said it hoped it would soon be able to make an announcement in that area.
